name: claude-mods
description: Claude Code mods for keeping an eye on usage limits and which models your agents run on

plugins.name: usage-limits
plugins.description: Keeps the 5-hour and weekly limit windows, reset countdowns, context fill and session cost pinned under the prompt

plugins.name: session-models
plugins.description: Shows the main model and how many agents (main thread, subagents, in-process teammates) have used each model
